posts.title: The Work We Do
posts.excerpt: “Your work is going to fill a large part of your life and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work”
posts.body:
Building Buzzz transcends Buzzz itself. At the heart of it, Buzzz is a reflection of the people we are, the values we believe in, the future we want to see, the passions we nurture, the philosophies we hold as persons and many more things beyond what I can currently muster.

This is all about the people that we are and not just the company that we are building.

Walk with Me.

Many weeks back, I had a tough time answering a pretty simple poll which asked this:

> **“The work you do” or “The money you make”**

Without any doubt, both are important and in most cases, it just might be illogical to pick one over the other since both might not be mutually exclusive. But in this case, I had to choose and it was, to me, a moment of epiphany because my choice just solidified certain beliefs I had previously held in high esteem. I"ll leave us to guess the possible answer I chose but will give some cues as we go ahead with the article.

You know, Steve Jobs once said:

> ***“Your work is going to fill a large part of your life and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work”***

Over the past few months, we have had our convictions tested, we have had to answer the hard questions, we have had to do the hard work, we have had to say goodbye to fantastic teammates, we have had to agree on what necessary compromises to make to build a great product.

We have worked hard not just to have dreams but to make those dreams become materialized because not until we do that will history accord us the names we aspire to have in its books.

You see, Buzzz was founded by a group of people who stand for values out of the ordinary.

We believe that every man is a craftsman who is capable of engineering a future everyone wants to be a part of, we believe that we are capable of creating products the world would have no choice but to use, we believe that every "delusional" idea is a possibility which only takes the right people, proper execution and time to be brought to life.

We are not real people and we do not, in any manner, desire to be real.

Of a truth:

> **Our dreams might be petrifying**
>
> **The policies might be stagnating**
>
> **The current technological infrastructure might be a limiter**
>
> **Percentage chances that make provisions for failure exist**

But we have studied and seen patterns in history that suggest certain interesting things. We have seen figures whom we most admire, who are seen as geniuses but were secretly rebels, impossible people, and delusional beings. They were tagged as estupidos because they dared to dream beyond the existing spectrum of possibilities. These figures have added remarkable value to the forward march of the Human Endeavour.

We must not forget that they were tagged as delusional but with persistence, hard work, and intelligence amongst other virtues, they worked and boy did their delusions add to the quota of the advancements we have had so far.

May the dreamers dream.

We have decided to be the dreamers, the misfits, the delusional ones, the impossible people who will add our valuable slice to the Human endeavour.

We have decided to push our cognitive abilities to their limits and we cannot be convinced otherwise that if we chase our goals with determined might long enough, we will achieve them.

We have decided first to be a group of great people, then we can make a great product.

We are people who want to live beyond the cliche of materialism, good salaries, and fame.

We believe that future possibilities are only possible once people make it happen.

This is who we are at Buzzz.
Buzzz is a reflection of what we are.

### Working on Buzzz

Buzzz aims to be the "Merch" Gateway for the Internet and by extension to increase the GDP of the Creator economy.

“We think anyone with an idea and people to share it with is a creator. And we believe anyone can be one. Buzzz empowers African creators to monetize their influence by enabling them to create and sell their own products to their fans and audience without needing to buy inventory or have any money to start. We take care of sourcing the products, printing your designs on them, handling customer service, and delivering orders. Our aim is to give creators everything they need to make their ideas come to life.”

Months have passed and we have worked hard to bring the vision to life and at this point, we are proud to have a fully functional MVP [yourbuzzz.com](https://www.yourbuzzz.com/).

We decided that this is going to be a product with a great User Experience and despite the technical challenges faced along the way, we have been able, so far, to build an MVP we are proud of.

For certain functionalities, we have had to work with various stakeholders including a 3d artist, we went as far as working with foreign developers who were not, at the time of contact, proficient with the English language, we have also worked with several other fantastic developers, designers and even potential customers just so that we can create a product with a great experience - just to get the job done.

As much as most of us are programmers, our taste for aesthetics and a good experience brings even designers to awe - Buzzz aims not just to be a product but one which oozes an aura of freedom, aesthetics and creativity and we believe that this creativity must be achieved internally before we can harvest the creativity in our customers.

We aim to build a template for a "typisches Produkt" that everyone should build - a combination of art and technology.

You know, who even works on the creator economy when there are a thousand and one other sectors to work on?

We have had potential investors tell us:

> ***“Sorry, we would have loved to invest in the fantastic idea but the creator economy is not within our range”***

We giggled and said:

> ***“After Buzzz, investors would scout for companies working on the creator economy because we would have proven a point”***

The silver lining gets closer and clearer. As a creator, individual, community, family, movement, belief, join us to convert memories, moments and memes into merch.

We are currently working on our Version 1 which is packed with a lot of amazing features such as:

**“Merch-as-tickets”**

**“Premium tagged products”**

**“Virtual collectibles”**

**“Merch GPT”**

And so much more.

Watch out and see what we have in store for us.

> ***“Till we see a merch on the street and be ninety per cent sure Buzzz facilitated the order, whether it be a tee, a cup, a skateboard, a wristband, a hoodie, a phone pouch, a sock, a cap, a pen, a sticker or whatever “merch” might mean to you, we will keep working……”***

This is the work we do at Buzzz.
posts.author: Kajoteni

posts.title: Cycles and political affairs
posts.excerpt: “those in my generation who I know have an interest in politics, sadly, turn out not to be a silver lining but are just the regurgitated images of the leaders we don't want.”
posts.body:
I had a long conversation with a friend today.
On cycles. Political cycles.

> **"The odds are high that the next generation of children will also take up the role of ranting on Twitter a few years from now if we don't sit with thoughts of engaging in the change that we want to see."** I said.

Of all of the bright friends or acquaintances or mates I have, none of them ever expressed interest in politicking, they either show apathy or disinterest and I seriously wonder at the fact that those in my generation who I know have an interest in politics, sadly, turn out not to be a silver lining but are just the regurgitated images of the leaders we don't want.

You know those kinds of people - charlatans.

Why would we rather give suggestions to the government from the corner of our rooms?
Why is everyone a good President or legislator in the comfort of their homes?
Why are we not willing to do the perhaps 'thankless tasks'?

From the handful of what I know, I shared with him some of the things I've seen happen (and not just heard) in that space. I said:
“These things I know, there are sons of legislators, governors and the likes who know them and have decided to sail their Fathers' course”. I told him of the rot in the system that I have seen (and not just heard of) and how one who would want to truly lead need to take power because in this context, no one would give you political power, really.

You take it.

While I'm here at least trying to be patriotic (beyond vocal means) because of the same things I've seen, some young, brilliant chap from a rich background somewhere knows the state of things but have decided to repeat the same cycle of gluttony and self-interest which leads to the continuous menace that befalls us.

He probably, fortunately, currently schools in one of Earth's most elite colleges.
Solid guy, undoubtedly - intellectually formidable candidate.

And then would he come in about 20 years from now when we all are of qualified age, run, and win the elections while some by then will still sit down and discuss the state of politics at 9:55am with their office colleagues forgetting that they had a chance. They had a chance but people no different, no taller, no smarter than them - their previous classmates, friends, agemates occupy the offices.

Then the youths in those coming days will complain bitterly about the state of the nation, and will also grow up and do nothing…
Mirroring the repeating patterns of political cycles and affairs that have persisted throughout recorded history.

Well..

> **"Inevitably, when the supply is depleted, the struggle for what remains leads to catastrophic change"**
> - [dinner for few](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HTDdIO74BuA)

We better wake up and wake up fast.
posts.author: Kajoteni
